# S10 — Embedded role prompts seeded from slicer contract v7; ork roles print

ork's own role prompts, embedded in the binary and canonical
(`roles.prompts`): implementer, reviewer, gate and architect, plus the
contract version pin they are written against.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**2026-10-19** — Review notes: TestPromptUnknownName survives removing the slices.Contains guard (equivalent mutation, kept as a guard). Fix-round red evidence was reintroduction mutations. The report shape (Tests line, ## Owner needed section, first-line format, placeholder set) is proposed in design.md, not decided.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**Not in this slice:** the brief builder and placeholder filling (S04), the `ork roles print` command (S03), split-part and sliver prompts (S08), and any change to the agents repo.

## Why

ork launches every role headlessly with no orchestrator agent
(`launch.mode`), so the prompts carry the rules a role needs that slicer's
contract gives the orchestrator today. They are seeded from slicer's v7
contract and written fresh where needed (`roles.prompt-seed`), and the
agents repo will generate its role files from them (`ork roles print`, S03).

## Files

- `internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md`, `reviewer.md`, `gate.md`,
  `architect.md` (new).
- `internal/roles/roles.go`, `internal/roles/roles_test.go` (new): embed the
  prompts with `embed`, `Names()`, `Prompt(name)`, `ContractVersion`.

## Failing tests

- `Names()` returns implementer, reviewer, gate, architect, in that order.
- `Prompt` of an unknown name returns an error naming it.
- `ContractVersion` is `7` and equals the version in the recorded
  `slicer ai relay` first line (`Contract: relay v7`).
- Every prompt starts with a line naming its role and the contract version.
- No prompt mentions Claude Code-only mechanics: `rg -i` for `Agent tool`,
  `SendMessage`, `subagent`, `TodoWrite` finds nothing in the prompts.
- Every prompt names the report path placeholder `{{report_path}}` and the
  temp directory placeholder `{{temp_dir}}`; the gate prompt says its report's
  first line is exactly `VERDICT: PASS` or `VERDICT: FAIL`.
- The reviewer, gate and architect prompts say the role is read-only and
  must not change the tree.

## Implement

- Seed from `slicer ai relay` and `slicer ai relay-orchestrator` (read with
  `--root` on this repo) and, for wording only, the agents repo's
  `multi-agent-workflows/relay-roles/*.md` (read-only). Do not paste the
  contract; write what each role itself must do.
- Each prompt covers: what the role owns, its slicer steps (implementer:
  `slicer start ID --render --strict`, red tests, mutation-check, closing
  note and finish step only after PASS), the tracking rule, the workspace
  and temp-dir limits, run long commands in the foreground, never commit,
  owner questions go in the report under "Owner needed" (`owner.questions`),
  and the report shape ork validates (design.md, Roles).
- Placeholders are `{{name}}` and are filled by the engine (S04); list them
  in a comment at the top of `roles.go`.
